Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
section_summary: This section contains State Department and military records concerning Emperor Hirohito's war responsibility, his retention on the imperial throne, and the question of his abdication. It includes a January 1946 CINCAFPAC message recommending Allied burden-sharing if heads of state decided to try the Emperor as a war criminal, alongside a February 1948 airgram from London transmitting a Manchester Guardian editorial on the British perspective of MacArthur's monarchical policy. Additionally, a November 1948 airgram from USPOLAD Tokyo reports that Emperor Hirohito privately informed General MacArthur of his definitive decision not to abdicate following the sentencing of major war criminals by the Tokyo tribunal.

subfiles.about: Concluding page of a classified message from CINCAFPAC advising on Allied occupation preparations should heads of state decide to try the Emperor as a war criminal.
subfiles.summary: CINCAFPAC recommends Allied burden-sharing in occupation forces if heads of state decide to try the Emperor as a war criminal.
subfiles.title: Incoming Classified Message CA 57235 on Trial of the Emperor and Allied Occupation Policy

subfiles.about: An airgram from the American Embassy in London transmitting a Manchester Guardian editorial that assesses Emperor Hirohito's war responsibility and General MacArthur's policy.
subfiles.summary: Transmits a Manchester Guardian editorial supporting Hirohito's retention on expediency grounds while discussing his war knowledge and MacArthur's policy.
subfiles.title: Airgram A-313 from London Forwarding Manchester Guardian Editorial on Emperor Hirohito

subfiles.about: An airgram from USPOLAD Tokyo reporting private information that Emperor Hirohito notified General MacArthur of his decision not to abdicate despite Tokyo trial verdicts.

subfiles.summary: Reports that an adviser privately informed USPOLAD that Emperor Hirohito notified General MacArthur he will not abdicate despite tribunal sentences.
subfiles.title: Airgram from USPOLAD Tokyo Reporting Emperor Hirohito's Decision Not to Abdicate
